notes.title: Giant Bear Rampage! V1.06 UPDATE! 🐻
notes.notes:
[h1]Firstly, [b]A BIG THANK YOU[/b] to anyone taking the time to read this! [/h1]

After releasing the Anniversary Update (v1.05) I have been listening to your feedback, reviews and adding to the game in order to make it better than ever.

[b]Since the 3-Year Anniversary, I have continued building and improving🐻[/b]
[url=https://twitter.com/GameDevMikey][b]@GameDevMikey[/b] is my twitter handle if you want to get in touch.[/url]

[h3][b]☢️ New Radar Ability! 🐻[/b][/h3]
[b]Use the Radar ability to find collectable mutation points and unlock powers![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/607c7514662acd2989c2adda75083ce3267b96d7.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☢️ Create New Bear Menu! 🐻[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]🐻 A List of Improvements ☢️[/b][/h3]

- Reset Warning for New Bear Added.
- Font Style on Settings Page Updated to Match Game Style.
- Adjusted Super Power Unlock Cost.

- Added Key-Bind Settings for Radar Ability.
- Updated Mutation Point Tutorial and Game Intro Tutorial.


[h1]💻Thanks to the YouTubers and Streamers too...😎[/h1]
[b]Your help in sharing my game is appreciated more than you think, it helps people discover the projects I put a ton of time, effort and love into. Here is a png version of the Giant Bear Rampage logo, So that you can use it in your thumbnails.[/b]

notes.title: Giant Bear Rampage - Halloween Update V1.04
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/57182e305457b75e56ca723275505c4d63ac557f.jpg[/img]

Halloween Update V1.04 is Now Live!

The Update Includes a new [b]Cheat Code[/b] system and an optional Blood Mode.

The option is available on the Main Menu on the Level Select Screen. It will be further expanded upon in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/81628fa70f2cbf60a7ac9e4d38b011d73cd56506.png[/img]

[b]To Access the Cheat Code Menu, Press the "K" key on the Pause Menu.
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35178303/2f4b172572f82c07394dec518d35d33dcb1d6079.jpg[/img]

The Cheat code system will added to in upcoming and future updates. :)

[b]Usable Cheat Codes.[/b]

[b]UnlimitedPower[/b] - Gives you Very fast regenerating energy! Spam super powers etc... 

[b]Bulletproof[/b] - Gives you Very fast regenerating health!

[b]HypedUp[/b] - Normal speed is equivalent to sprinting!

[b]SpringLoaded[/b] - Double's your jump height!

[b]Bloating[/b] - Double your size.

[b]Thinn[/b] - Half your size.

[b]ResetBear[/b] - Return to normal bear size.

Please give your suggestions for other cheat codes I could add! 🐻
